stem.text: A disc of mass $M$ is moving across a horizontal frictionless surface with constant velocity $u$. It collides with a stationary disc of mass $4M$.
The diagram shows the view from above of the motion of the two discs before and after the collision.

stem.alt: View from above of a disc moving to the right towards a stationary disc, labelled before collision
View from above of two discs moving away after a collision, with speeds 4.0 m s-1 and v and angles of 45° labelled, labelled after collision
